create_SamAutomaticMaskGenerator: create a SamAutomaticMaskGenerator instance with a SAM model and configurable mask generation parameters
run_generate_masks: run the generate method to produce segmentation masks for a given image as a list of mask records
filter_masks_by_iou: filter generated masks by predicted IoU threshold to keep only high-quality mask predictions
postprocess_small_regions: postprocess masks to remove small disconnected regions and holes, then rerun NMS to eliminate duplicates
generate_crop_masks: generate masks by processing image crops at multiple layers to capture masks at different scales
